newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton prices firm but trade cautious.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton prices firm but trade cautious.

text.p: Most European raw cotton markets saw cautious trade as sellers quoted higher prices while offtake of yarns and fabric styles in habitually solid demand remained relatively static, industry sources said.
Traders in Portugal, Italy and Belgium reported improved buying interest in Central Asian, West African and selected Middle Eastern descriptions for second-quarter delivery.
But sources in Eastern Europe painted a picture of a quiet, featureless market although some modest enquiry for American Pima styles was seen. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
